name: raclink-desktop
description: RacLink for Windows — the AI Workspace as a native desktop app, with FinCodes: AI employees coding on this computer.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && cross-env RACLINK_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.dev:local: npm run build && cross-env RACLINK_DEV=1 RACLINK_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run vendor:fincodes && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run vendor:fincodes && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
